caption: The drawing depicts a clear, oval-shaped glass bowl with a scalloped rim and faceted sides, rendered in a grayscale pencil or ink medium. The bowl has a broad, shallow body with a series of rounded panels forming its outer edge, each panel separated by a groove, giving the bowl a segmented appearance. Shading is used to create the effect of transparency and depth, emphasizing the glass material. The main illustration occupies the center of the page, enclosed within a rectangular frame. In the lower left corner, there is a separate inset showing a top-down, plan-view line drawing of the same bowl, illustrating its geometric layout with an oval inside two larger concentric oval shapes, divided into segments corresponding to the panels seen in the main drawing. The paper is off-white, and there is a signature "Hugh Clarke" in the bottom right corner of the drawing. There are no other objects or embellishments present in the composition.
title: Fruit Dish
